sourceFactsParaphrased.fact: The methodology defines neighborhood comparison extents using settlement-structure and administrative data.
Chapter3.4 characterizes actual named neighborhoods individually; its parameters include urban structure, character, infrastructure and environmental indicators.
One chapter heading groups Neszele and Ságod. Its map panels independently label and delineate Neszele and Ságod as two visible source extents, both numbered16.

Narrative discussion separately identifies Neszele and Ságod as neighborhoods, while green-space provision is explicitly interpreted using combined statistics. This is an aggregation of indicators, not evidence that the two contours are geometric aliases.
